question: When RBI decides to decrease the repo rate, money supply will _________.

options.text: initially stay constant and then decrease

solution:
The correct answer is** __Increase__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** decides to **decrease the repo rate, **it reduces the cost at which banks can borrow money from it.
 
• This **reduction in borrowing costs** is intended to encourage banks to lend more to businesses and consumers.
 
• As banks** increase lending**, the overall money supply in the economy **increases,** which can help stimulate economic growth.
 
• An **increase in money supply** typically leads to **lower interest rates, making loans cheaper for borrowers.**
 
• This policy action **can be used by the RBI **as a tool to combat economic slowdowns by encouraging spending and investment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Main Keyword
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Repo Rat**e
 The rate at which the central bank of a country (RBI in the case of India) lends money to commercial banks to maintain liquidity, in the event of any shortfall of funds.
 
 

 **Monetary Policy**
 A financial policy tool used by the RBI to control the supply of money, availability, and cost of credit in the economy.
 
 

 **Inflation Control**
 One of the objectives of adjusting the repo rate is to control inflation. Lowering the repo rate can lead to higher inflation, whereas increasing it can help in cooling down inflation.
 
 

 **Economic Growth**
 Adjusting the repo rate is a measure to influence the level of economic activity and employment. The ultimate objective is to achieve a high and sustainable rate of economic growth.
 
 

 **Liquidity Management**
 The process by which the central bank ensures that the banking system has enough liquidity to meet its obligations and support economic activities.
